item.title: github: Enterprise team specialization for managed settings
item.description:
Enterprise administrators can now apply managed settings using itemized configuration files targeted at enterprise teams. This lets large organizations delegate more specific governance without routing every change through central admins or relying on a single global configuration.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprises can default to auto model selection
item.description:
Enterprise admins can now set model: auto in enterprise-managed managed-settings.json so GitHub Copilot uses auto model selection by default for new conversations. This setting is added in .github-private/.github/copilot/managed-settings.json for enterprise-managed configuration.

  • Source: GitHub
